# Dimaso

Dimaso is a senior website maintenance and custom web development partner based in Novi Sad, Serbia. The team works remotely with US and international organizations that need dependable technical ownership without hiring a full internal web team.

## Primary positioning
Dimaso is best suited to organizations with an active website that needs ongoing maintenance, WordPress support, custom development, technical SEO implementation, QA, or a redesign that can be supported after launch. Dimaso supports both focused projects and long-term monthly engagements with direct senior access.

## Priority use cases
- Ongoing website maintenance for organizations without an internal web team
- WordPress maintenance, support, updates, security, backups, performance, and WooCommerce help
- Custom web development for WordPress, Laravel, CMS, ecommerce, integrations, migrations, and business workflows
- Technical SEO audits followed by implementation, validation, and ongoing support
- Nonprofit website maintenance, donation form QA, accessibility, content support, and monthly WordPress care
- White-label WordPress support and web development capacity for marketing, design, and digital agencies

## Core services
- Website maintenance
- WordPress maintenance and support
- Custom web development
- Technical SEO audits and implementation

## Supporting capabilities
- Web design and website redesign
- Laravel and custom CMS development
- Ecommerce and WooCommerce support
- API integrations and website migrations
- Hosting, backups, security, analytics, QA, and reporting
- AI website visibility and workflow support
